title: Schedule A to the Member Handbook: Entry Requirements and Meeting Rights of the Membership and Patronage Equity Classes
content:
## Schedule A — entry and standing

Membership and Patronage Equity is held in six classes. This schedule states, class by class, what the cooperative requires before a class may be held, what the class carries at the annual meeting, and the business a fiscal year must show before the class earns anything for that year.

| Class | Whole fiscal years of membership required | Common stock shares required | Par value of one share, USD | Application fee, USD | Votes at the annual meeting | Proxy voting | Notice of the annual meeting, calendar days | Fiscal years without qualifying business before the membership is treated as inactive | Business a fiscal year must show to qualify, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | 0 | 0 | 25.00 | 0.00 | no | no | 21 | 3 | 500.00 |
| Class A Voting Membership | 1 | 1 | 25.00 | 25.00 | yes | yes | 21 | 3 | 2500.00 |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | 3 | 1 | 25.00 | 25.00 | no | no | 21 | 5 | 25000.00 |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | 1 | 0 | 25.00 | 0.00 | no | no | 21 | 10 | 0.00 |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | 10 | 1 | 25.00 | 0.00 | yes | yes | 21 | 10 | 0.00 |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | 0 | 0 | 25.00 | 0.00 | no | no | 21 | 10 | 0.00 |

## Notes on the columns

1. Years of membership are counted in whole fiscal years from the date the membership was accepted by the board.
2. Where a class calls for common stock, the number of shares in the second column is what the class carries; the par value in the third column is the value of one such share and is 25.00 on every class.
3. The two classes that vote are the two classes on which a proxy may be lodged; the other four neither vote nor admit a proxy.
4. Notice of the annual meeting is 21 calendar days on every class of Membership and Patronage Equity.
5. The last column is the qualifying business a fiscal year must show on the class. Where a fiscal year's business falls under it, the class earns no allocation for that year.

## Points of judgement

**A member wishes to hold the Class B Preferred Equity Membership and has been on the books two whole fiscal years.** The class calls for three, so the entry requirement of that class is not met on the years column.

**A member has been on the books eleven whole fiscal years and holds one share of common stock.** Both the years column and the stock column of the Age Retirement Equity Membership are satisfied, that class calling for 10 years and 1 share.

**A Retained Patronage Certificate Holding has shown no qualifying business for four fiscal years.** The inactivity column for that class is 10 fiscal years, so four years without business does not reach it.
